title: Samaan recipe eval manifest
description: Private recording test set for scripts/recipe-eval.ts. The manifest, recordings, and transcripts live outside this repo. Paths are relative to the manifest.

audio.description: Recording trimmed to the recipe. Sent to the transcription provider.

transcript.description: Plain-text transcript, for example from an old on-device build. Skips transcription.

must_include.description: English ingredient names that must each appear.

must_include_any.description: Groups where at least one name must appear.

must_not_include.description: Names that must not appear, such as known mishearings.
